turns.q: My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
turns.replyTail:
We’ll get this looked at for you.

To help our team review everything, can you please reply with:

Your email address
Your order number (or your full name and shipping address if you don’t have the order number handy)
The name of the damaged item
A few clear photos of:
The damaged item
The pot or container and soil surface
The shipping box and any packaging it came with

Once you share those details and photos, our team will review the situation and be in touch with next steps.
